cancellationPolicy.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellationPolicy.intro: We know plans change. Here's exactly what happens if you need to cancel your booking.
cancellationPolicy.tier1_body: If you cancel within 24 hours of making your booking, and your trip start date is more than 48 hours away, you'll receive a 100% refund of your deposit.
cancellationPolicy.tier2_body: Cancellations made 30 or more days before your start date are refunded 95% of the deposit.
cancellationPolicy.tier3_title: Cancel less than 30 days before departure
cancellationPolicy.tier3_body: Cancellations made less than 30 days before your start date are not eligible for a deposit refund. Your booking will still be cancelled and the dates released — we will not attempt to charge the remaining balance.
cancellationPolicy.tier4_body: Exceptional circumstances (medical emergencies, natural disasters, etc.) are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please contact us directly.

cancelBooking.title: Cancel Your Booking
cancelBooking.intro: Enter your booking reference and last name, or your email and last name, to look up your reservation.

cancelBooking.error_not_found: No matching booking found. Double-check your reference or details.
cancelBooking.error_ambiguous: We found multiple bookings for that email. Please use your booking reference instead.
cancelBooking.error_already_cancelled: This booking has already been cancelled.
cancelBooking.error_refund_failed: We couldn't process the refund right now. Please try again or contact us.
cancelBooking.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
cancelBooking.quote_refund_full: You will be refunded {{pct}}% (€{{amount}}) of your deposit.
cancelBooking.quote_refund_zero: Your deposit is non-refundable at this stage, but your booking will be cancelled and the dates released.
cancelBooking.done_body: Your booking has been cancelled. A confirmation email is on its way — refunds typically arrive within 5–10 business days.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Last updated: August 2026
privacy.s1_body: Camper Retreat S.L., CIF B56742075, Valencia, Spain. Contact email: info@campervlc.com.
privacy.s2_body: Name, email address and phone number submitted via the booking form, plus browsing data collected by Google Analytics (anonymised IP, pages visited, session duration). Payments are handled entirely by Stripe; Camper Retreat S.L. does not store card details.
privacy.s3_body: To manage bookings and communications related to the rental service, to send confirmations and invoices, and to improve the website through anonymous usage statistics.
privacy.s4_body: Performance of a contract (GDPR Art. 6.1.b) for booking data; legitimate interest (Art. 6.1.f) for usage statistics.
privacy.s5_body: Booking data is kept for the duration of the contractual relationship and up to 5 years thereafter to meet legal obligations. Analytics data is automatically deleted after 14 months.
privacy.s6_body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict or object to the processing of your data, and to data portability. To exercise these rights, write to info@campervlc.com. You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).
privacy.s7_body: Google Analytics and Stripe may transfer data outside the EEA under appropriate safeguards (Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission).

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.subtitle: Last updated: August 2026
terms.s1_body: This agreement is between Camper Retreat S.L. (CIF B56742075, Valencia, Spain) as lessor and the customer making the booking as lessee.
terms.s2_body: Rental of the leisure vehicle McLouis Yearling 89G for private tourist use for the period stated in the booking.
terms.s3_body: The main driver must be at least 21 years old, hold a category B driving licence with at least 2 years of history, and present a valid ID or passport at pick-up.
terms.s4_body: The price is calculated at the rate in force at the time of booking. A 50% deposit is required to confirm the reservation. The remaining 50% is due before vehicle pick-up. Full payment in advance carries a 5% discount.
terms.s5_body: A security deposit of €900 will be pre-authorised by credit card at pick-up and released within 7 business days after return, provided the vehicle shows no damage or incidents.
terms.s6_body: The vehicle may not be taken outside Spain without prior written authorisation. Commercial use, goods transport and participation in competitions are prohibited. The driver must comply with all applicable traffic laws and speed limits.
terms.s7_body: The base price includes fully comprehensive insurance with a standard excess. The customer may add the reduced-excess option as an extra. Damage caused by gross negligence, driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs, or breach of these terms is not covered.
terms.s8_body: Cancellations are governed by the Cancellation Policy available at campervlc.com/cancellation-policy.
terms.s9_body: This agreement is governed by Spanish law. Disputes shall be submitted to the courts of Valencia.
